items.title: September intake now open
items.body: Our next Beginner Course intake starts 1 September. Spaces are limited to 15 learners per group — book early to secure a morning slot.

items.title: New evening slots in Blantyre
items.body: By popular request, the Blantyre branch now offers 17:30–18:30 lessons on weekdays for learners who work during the day.

items.title: Motorcycle course now includes night riding practice
items.body: We've extended the Motorcycle Course to include a supervised night-riding session, covering visibility and hazard awareness after dark.

items.title: Testing
items.body:
Does it work? Learning to drive is an important milestone that opens doors to independence, employment, and personal growth. At Chimwemwe Driving School, we provide professional driving lessons tailored to beginners and experienced drivers alike.
Read More

Our experienced instructors guide students through both theory and practical lessons, ensuring they understand road signs, traffic regulations, defensive driving techniques, and vehicle control. We are committed to producing confident, responsible, and safety-conscious drivers.

We offer flexible lesson schedules, affordable packages, and modern training vehicles to accommodate different learning needs. Whether you are preparing for your first driving test or looking to refresh your driving skills, Chimwemwe Driving School is here to help you succeed.
